description: This file defines an API router for authentication endpoints using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for user sign-up, email verification, sign-in, password reset, and related functionalities, integrating with Supabase and email services.

methods.name: SignUpResponse signup( payload: SignUpRequest, request: Request, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), email_service: EmailService = Depends(provide_email_service), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Creates a new user in Supabase and sends a verification email.

methods.name: None send_verification_code( payload: SendVerificationCodeRequest, request: Request, email_service: EmailService = Depends(provide_email_service), supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Sends a verification code to the user's email.

methods.name: None verify_code( payload: VerifyCodeRequest, request: Request, )
methods.description: Verifies email through a code (placeholder, relies on Supabase link verification).

methods.name: AuthTokenResponse signin( payload: SignInRequest, request: Request, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Authenticates a user and returns an access token.

methods.name: None forgot_password( payload: ForgotPasswordRequest, request: Request, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), email_service: EmailService = Depends(provide_email_service), settings: Settings = Depends(provide_settings), )
methods.description: Initiates password recovery process by sending reset link.

methods.name: None reset_password( payload: ResetPasswordRequest, request: Request, supabase: SupabaseAdminClient = Depends(provide_supabase_client), )
methods.description: Resets the user password, optionally via admin privileges.

ctags.name: _RATE_LIMIT_MAX
ctags.pattern: /^_RATE_LIMIT_MAX = 30  # 30 requests per minute per IP by default$/
